theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_fa_pj_polar_fderiv_apply
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (a e x : Euclid P), inner ℝ x a ≠ 0 → ∀ v : Euclid P, fderiv ℝ (fun y : Euclid P => (‖y‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a))) x v = (inner ℝ x v / ‖x‖, inner ℝ (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a) v / (inner ℝ x a ^ 2 + inner ℝ x e ^ 2))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
